info.title: Five Nights at Edward's
info.author: Edward's Province
info.description: FNaF fan-game for the Wii U!
info.details:
Five Nights at Edward's is a fan-made survival horror game inspired by the mechanics and atmosphere of classic Five Nights-style games. The goal is simple: survive the night while managing limited resources and responding to unpredictable threats.

What Makes It Different?
Unlike other projects, this project focuses on our original characters and Roblox UGC series: Edward the Devil, NomNom the Dino, Big the Boulder, And Smiley the Clown, giving fans a unique world and story you won’t find anywhere else.

Development
The game is currently almost finished, with just one visual update planned, but balance changes or other small modifications or patches may be released in the future.

Disclaimer
This is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Scott Cawthon or the official Five Nights at Freddy's franchise.
